ver: Artifact-level version counter. Incremented on every write.
meta.title: Application name, copied from PRD meta.title.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
auth.mechanism: Authentication mechanism used across the project — e.g. 'JWT (Bearer token)', 'Session cookie', 'API key', 'OAuth 2.0'. Derive from arch-spec nfr/tech_stack.
auth.session_strategy: How sessions are managed — e.g. 'Access token 15min + refresh token 7 days', 'Server-side session with Redis', 'Stateless JWT'. Empty string if not applicable.
auth.notes: Any additional auth notes — e.g. 'Multi-tenant: token includes tenant_id claim', 'Logout invalidates refresh token server-side'. Empty string if none.
error_format.structure: Shape of all error responses. Describe the JSON structure — e.g. '{ "error": "message", "code": "ERROR_CODE" }' or '{ "errors": [{"field": "name", "message": "required"}] }'.
error_format.example: A concrete example of the error response JSON as a string.
error_format.notes: Any additional notes — e.g. 'Validation errors use 422 with field-level errors array'. Empty string if none.
pagination.strategy: Pagination approach for list endpoints — e.g. 'Offset-based (page + per_page)', 'Cursor-based (cursor + limit)', 'None (all results returned)'.
pagination.defaults: Default values — e.g. 'page=1, per_page=20, max per_page=100' or 'limit=20, max=200'.
pagination.notes: Any additional notes — e.g. 'All list endpoints return pagination metadata in response'. Empty string if none.
naming_conventions.api_endpoints: Naming style for API paths — e.g. 'snake_case: /api/product_orders', 'kebab-case: /api/product-orders', 'camelCase: /api/productOrders'.
naming_conventions.db_tables: Naming style for database table names — e.g. 'snake_case plural: orders, product_variants'.
naming_conventions.db_columns: Naming style for database column names — e.g. 'snake_case: created_at, user_id'.
naming_conventions.notes: Any additional naming notes — e.g. 'JSON response fields use camelCase', 'Enum values stored as UPPER_SNAKE_CASE'. Empty string if none.
integrations: Technical details for each external integration listed in arch-spec. One entry per integration. Empty array if no integrations.
integrations[].name: Integration name — must match the name in arch-spec.integrations.
integrations[].auth_method: How this integration authenticates — e.g. 'API key (header: X-API-Key)', 'OAuth 2.0 client credentials', 'Basic auth'.
integrations[].key_config: Where credentials are configured — e.g. 'env var: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY', 'env vars: SENDGRID_API_KEY'. Follow the naming convention from arch-spec.
integrations[].notes: Any integration-specific technical notes — e.g. 'Use webhook signature verification for events', 'Idempotency key required on all charge requests'. Empty string if none.
other_decisions: Any other project-wide technical decisions not covered above. Each entry is a free-form string — e.g. 'All timestamps stored as UTC in ISO 8601 format', 'Soft-delete via deleted_at column on all core entities', 'File uploads stored in S3 bucket via pre-signed URLs'. Empty array if none.
